messages.subject: PC axes and morph disparity
parts:
Hi everyone,

I extracted Procrustes shape variables describing 95% of the variation (PC1-PC4) in my data and plotted shape changes in morphospace. By plotting the warps I know what shape changes are described along each PC axis. For example, PC1 describes elongated (PC1 min) to stout (PC1 max) bird beak shapes. Would it be sensible to calculate some measure of variance/morph disparity among my species using the PC scores for each PC axis (e.g. compare species X PC1 to species Y PC1 scores) as opposed to calculating disparity by using combined PC axes as done in the morph.disparity function?

Nick

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] PC axes and morph disparity
parts:
Nick,

 

Please read the help files. The function morphol.disparity can be used on a single continuous variable, and in fact there is an example of this in that help file.


Dean
